people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: Every meal offering, mixed with oil or dry, belongs to all the sons of Aaron, one as well as another.
translations.bsb: and every grain offering, whether dry or mixed with oil, belongs equally to all the sons of Aaron.
translations.kjv: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
translations.asv: And every meal-offering, mingled with oil, or dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as well as another.
